subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Assertion (A) : A memory less system is causal. 
 
Reason (R) : A system is causal if the output at any 
time depends only on values of input at that time and 
in the past. 
 
(a) Both A and R are true and R is the correct 
explanation of A 
 
(b) Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct 
explanation of A 
 
(c) A is true but R is false 
 
(d) A is false but R is true 
Convolution and Its Properties

options.text: Both A and R are true and R is the correct
Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
: A memory less system is causal.
